scientific limitations/integrity: Global complete classification and quantitative near-minimizer result for exactly three unoriented unit projection axes in Euclidean R3 with strictly positive calibrated weights. The numerical 1/3 error of the orthogonal rule is previously known; what is added is its global optimality, uniqueness and explicit sharp-exponent stability among arbitrary triples. The source convex-body defect identity, Cauchy formula and Minkowski existence supply the infinite-dimensional sharpness. No estimate for four or more directions, uncalibrated weights, or optimal angular stability constant is claimed.
title: Unique minimax three-view Cauchy cubature with quantitative frame rigidity
